name: rtemis-map-bundle
description: Build input for the vendored MapLibre GL + topojson-client + d3-scale-chromatic browser bundle used by the rtemis-map htmlwidget (choropleth maps). Run `npm install && npm run build` to regenerate inst/htmlwidgets/lib/maplibre/rtemis-map-deps.js. Versions are pinned to match rtemislive (~/Code/live).
